finalText:
The error was buried in `src/core/settings.js`. Line 17 tried to use an undefined variable `retries` instead of reading it from the env object that was passed in. I changed `maxRetries: retries` to `maxRetries: env.retries || 1` so it properly reads the retry count from the options or defaults to 1.

The build now finishes clean with 3 warnings and 0 errors.
